narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the repository structure.
finalText:
**1291 hits across 94 files.** Five places must not move.

| Zone | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `migrations/` (12 files) | 61 | Applied history. Write a new migration |
| SQL text in `services/*/src/repo/*.js` | 125 | Real column name. Needs that migration first |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` (4 files) | 20 | `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites edits |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Public contract. Frozen |
| `lib/serialize.js` WIRE values | 2 | Public JSON keys |

Safe to rename: 1078 hits. Those are params, locals, and internal keys.

The trap is [invoice.js:10](services/billing/src/repo/invoice.js:10). Param renames, SQL string stays.

Next: ask them if a column-rename migration ships too.
